create_modal_sandbox: create a ModalEnvironment with a Docker image, persistent filesystem, and task_id for cloud execution
run_bash_command: run a bash command string inside a Modal sandbox with optional login shell and timeout
upload_files_bulk: bulk upload local files to a Modal sandbox as a gzipped tar archive via base64 stdin
download_files_bulk: bulk download the .hermes directory from a Modal sandbox as a tar archive to a local path
snapshot_filesystem: snapshot and restore Modal sandbox filesystem state across sessions using persistent snapshots
